verdict.rationale: Mem0 ships a fully documented public REST API (OpenAPI spec verified live), official SDKs (Python/JS), a CLI, and an MCP server, all confirmed via live runtime probes (CLI works keylessly, SDK pip-installs, MCP server responds with proper OAuth challenge) in addition to extensive docs on quickstart, entity scoping, search, graph memory, and webhooks. missing for 10: independent third-party developer reviews specifically validating API robustness/completeness beyond vendor docs and automated probes.
